newsitem.title: USA: Arterial Vascular sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Arterial Vascular sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc said Thursday it had adopted a preferred stock purchase rights plan in which rights would become exercisable only if a person or group acquired 15 percent or more of Arterial's outstanding common stock.
The company said in a release that the rights could also become exercisable if a person or group announced a tender offer for 15 percent or more of the outstanding common stock.

The company said that under the plan, stockholders will receive one right to purchase 1/100 of a share of a new series of preferred stock for each outstanding share of Arterial's common stock held of record at the close of business on March 21, 1997.

The rights plan, Arterial said, is designed to "enable stockholders to realize the full value of their investment" and to "provide for fair and equal treatment in the event that an unsolicited attempt is made to acquire the company."
The company added that the adoption of the rights plan is "intended as a means to guard against abusive takeover tactics and is not in response to any proposal to acquire" Arterial Vascular.
Arterial said that the rights will be distributed as a non-taxable dividend and will expire in 10 years.
The company retained the services of Goldman Sachs & Co and Cowen & Co in connection with the adoption of the rights plan.
